Sells to wholesalers and specialty pharmacies that supply patients and prescribers in the US. Products are made by contract manufacturers.

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets CNS drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to drug wholesalers and pharmacies

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily United States commercial sales
